Class Distribution.Parameter

java.lang.Object
common.distributions.Distribution.Parameter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
Enclosing class:
Distribution
public class Distribution.Parameter extends Object implements Cloneable
This class describes a parameter. It can be instantiated only by Distribution and its subclassses but will be accessed with public methods

  • Constructor Details

    • Parameter

      public Parameter(String name, String description, Class<?> valueClass, Object defaultValue)
      Constructs a new Parameter object. If a custom check on input values is needed, a call to setValueChecker(ValueChecker checker) method must be performed.
      Parameters:
      name - name of this parameter
      description - brief description of this parameter usage
      valueClass - Class type of value of this parameter
      defaultValue - initial value for this parameter getParameterClasspath() for more details.

    • Parameter

      public Parameter(String name, String description, Class<?> valueClass, Object defaultValue, boolean directParameter)
      Constructs a new Parameter object. If a custom check on input values is needed, a call to setValueChecker(ValueChecker checker) method must be performed.
      Parameters:
      name - name of this parameter
      description - brief description of this parameter usage
      valueClass - Class type of value of this parameter
      defaultValue - initial value for this parameter
      directParameter - indicates if this parameter will be added to the distribution of the parameter object when translating it to XML getParameterClasspath() for more details.

      public void setValueChecker(Distribution.ValueChecker checker)
      Sets a ValueChecker to check if a parameter's value is in the correct range. If no checks are required do not call this method
      Parameters:

    • setValue

      public boolean setValue(Object value)
      Sets value for this parameter. Returns if parameter could be assigned correctly
      Parameters:
      value - value to be assigned to this parameter
      Returns:
      If value.class is different from valueClass, or parameter value is not valid, returns false, otherwise true

    • setValue

      public boolean setValue(String value)
      Sets value for this parameter. If parameter class is String sets it, otherwise try to parse string if parameter is of a known numeric type. Returns if parameter could be assigned correctly.
      Parameters:
      value - to be assigned to this parameter or to be parsed
      Returns:
      If value.class is different from valueClass, or parameter value is not parsable or valid, returns false, otherwise true

    • parseValue

      public Object parseValue(String value)
      Parses string if parameter is of a known numeric type.
      Parameters:
      value - value to be parsed
      Returns:
      If value.class is different from valueClass, or parameter value is not parsable, returns null, otherwise number

      public Object clone()
      Returns a shallow copy of this Parameter. Note that as nothing can be inferred about all values clonability, so parameters are only referenced and not cloned. This should not be a problem as every value should be an immutable type.
